svg.title: The target sheet
svg.desc: The second sheet under the Chart: medical graph paper with a printed target curve for height, day by day, in a shaded band that climbs from 178 cm to its last number, 338; five small plain figures stand on the day line getting taller, and a pencilled line of crosses lies exactly along the curve.
svg.text: PRINTED. DO NOT ENTER BELOW THE BAND.
PRINTED. DO NOT ENTER BELOW THE BAND.
